Name: Farm Cave Music
Author: circlejourney
Description:
[youtube]7S0sYG1GOpw[/youtube]

A simple mod that adds a peaceful music track to the farm cave and Ginger Island mushroom cave. Simply download and add to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to start using.

Please note that walking into the farm cave with music active in it will cause seasonal music to stop.

[size=4]Config options
[/size][list]
[*]FarmCaveMusic: set whether music should play in the farm cave
[*]IslandCaveMusic: set whether music should play in the Ginger Island mushroom cave
[*]Looping: set whether cave music should loop
[/list]
